heroSubtitle: The first decentralized health platform that puts your medical data in your control.
onboardingSubtitle: Your health, your guardian. The decentralized health platform.
onboardingRoleDesc: This determines which dashboard and features you'll have access to.
rolePatientDesc: Manage your health records, share with clinicians, track your wellness journey.
roleClinicianDesc: Scan patient passports, view health summaries, add clinical notes with consent.
roleCHWDesc: Monitor mesh activity, track outbreaks, register community health needs.
roleAdminDesc: Manage users, configure organization settings, view analytics and compliance.
healthProfileDesc: Add your current health information. This helps the AI provide accurate insights.
privacyConsentDesc: We're committed to protecting your data under the Nigeria Data Protection Act.
consentText: I understand and consent to have my health data processed according to the Privacy Policy.
termsAccepted: I have read and accept the Terms of Service.
setPassphraseDesc: This encrypts all your health data. Forgetting it means losing access to your records.
biometricDesc: Use your fingerprint or face to quickly unlock VitaChain after your passphrase expires.
biometricNotAvailableDesc: Your device doesn't support biometric authentication. You'll use your passphrase.
onboardingCompleteMsg: Your VitaChain account is ready. Your health data is secure.
supportSuccess: Thanks for reaching out! We'll get back to you within 24 hours.
supportError: Failed to send message. Please try again.
signOutConfirmMsg: Are you sure you want to sign out? You will need to sign in again to access your health data.
